originalTitle: 【Zelda: Majora's Mask】Time is just a concept and I will prove it here!
lead: A character requested a loud instrument to create noise and showed an ocarina.
summaryOneLine: A character requested a loud instrument to create noise and showed an ocarina.
keyPoints: Monkey's Distress and Shortcut to Deku Palace
Fear of Punishment and Time Reversal
articleBodyHtml:
Character Actions and Instruments

A character requested a loud instrument to create noise and showed an ocarina.

Monkey's Distress and Shortcut to Deku Palace

A monkey is distressed and urges the group to take a shortcut to Deku Palace to avoid punishment from the Deku King.

Fear of Punishment and Time Reversal

The speaker fears punishment from the Deku King and considers reversing time.

Decision to Take the Woodfall Shortcut

The group decides to take the Woodfall shortcut.

Heading Towards the Southern Swamp

They are heading towards the Southern Swamp.

Character's Plan to Do the Opposite

One character plans to do the opposite of what the others suggest, specifically not going to the castle.

Discussion of Shortcut to Woodfall Temple

The group is discussing taking a shortcut to Woodfall Temple above Waterfall from Deku Palace.

Assisting the Destiny-Changer

She is checking where the one with the power to change the destiny of this land is to help him.

Belief in Eternal Friendship Through Song

She believes that by playing the song carved on the stone, she can build eternal friendship with him.

Instructions to Leave Proof on Statues

She is instructing them to leave proof of their encounter on the statues.

Promise of Eternal Friendship

She is swearing eternal friendship with him.

Character's Experience with a Cutscene

A character experienced a cutscene and felt they did something great.

Expression of Frustration and Disbelief

A character expressed frustration and disbelief.

Enjoyment of the Situation

A character expressed enjoyment of the situation.

Attempting to Calm Down

A character attempted to calm themselves down.

Expression of Excitement and Amazement

A character expressed excitement and amazement.

Acknowledging Something

A character acknowledged something.

Confirming an Action

A character confirmed an action.

Bringing Something Back

They brought something back.

Reaction to the 'Sonata of Awakening!' Song

The characters are reacting to a song called 'Sonata of Awakening!'

Comment on Humans-Only Policy

Someone is saying that only humans are allowed, and they don't like scrubs.

Ability to Deposit All Money in the Bank

She can deposit all her money in the bank.

Making a 'Wee!' Sound

A character makes a 'Wee!' sound.

Repeating the Utterance 'We'll See'

Repeat utterance: 'We'll see.'

Command to Not Do Anything

Don't do anything!

Initiating an Action

Characters are initiating an action.
